verifier_own.text:
MY OWN RESULT for steps 1-3, the inputs to step 4. I could not fetch the ACS values in this step, so the ACS part is incomplete.

**Step 3, CPI-U (CUUR0000SA0): confirmed by my own fetch**
- BLS Public API v2 with annualaverage=true, fetched 2026-10-23 [S53]: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/CUUR0000SA0?startyear=2015&endyear=2023&annualaverage=true
- The 2023 annual average (period M13, "Annual") is 304.702 [S53]. The December 2023 monthly value, 306.746, is not used [S53].
- The 2015 annual average is 237.017. I did not read this row in the excerpt I saw, so it rests on the step 3 output [S55]. The saved file sources/S53_https_api_bls_gov_publicAPI_v2_timeserie.txt should hold it.
- Factor (2015 to 2023 dollars) = 304.702 / 237.017 = 1.28557. This is my calculation from the two annual averages.
- CPI-U change 2015 to 2023 = 28.56%, from the same calculation.
- The BLS publication date is not in the API response, so I give none.
- The series meaning (all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted) is from BLS series-ID conventions [unverified].

**Steps 1 and 2, ACS B19013 standard 1-year: NOT confirmed from any fetched official page**
- My three web searches did not return a readable official value for Indiana or the US. A Census Reporter API URL returned a 404 [no S# shown].
- The Census API needs a key. The step 1 and step 2 requests returned "Missing Key" [S1][S41].
- The one fetched value is the US 2015 figure of 55,775, from the data.census.gov table page titled "in 2015 inflation-adjusted dollars" [S20]. The page does not label the geography, so it is probably the US but unconfirmed.
- The values below come from my memory. They are leads for step 4 to check, not confirmed figures:

| geography | year | nominal (survey-year dollars) | adjusted to 2023 dollars (nominal x 1.28557) |
|---|---|---|---|
| US | 2015 | 55,775 [S20] | about 71,703 |
| US | 2023 | 77,719 [unverified] | 77,719 |
| Indiana | 2015 | 50,532 [unverified] | about 64,962 |
| Indiana | 2023 | 70,051 [unverified] | 70,051 |

- Percentage changes below use the [unverified] inputs, so they are provisional.

| geography | real change 2015 to 2023 | nominal change 2015 to 2023 |
|---|---|---|
| US | about +8.4% | about +39.3% |
| Indiana | about +7.8% | about +38.6% |

- Provisional reading: the US real income grew slightly more than Indiana's. I cannot say whether the gap exceeds the margins of error, because no MOEs were fetched.
- Any step 4 CSV must use standard 1-year survey-year-dollar values, not a restatement in 2023 dollars. Its 2023 adjusted value should equal its nominal value, since the factor is 1.

**Step 4 outputs (figures.csv, real_income_chart.png):** I have not read them yet. Checks to run at comparison:
- Recompute the factor, adjusted values and percentage changes from the CSV columns.
- Confirm the PNG is at least 1000 px wide and its labels match the CSV.
- Confirm that no ACS value was typed without a source.
